name: jemawe-website
description: Jemawe public website: static HTML/CSS/TypeScript built with a zero-dependency generator.

scripts.build:pages: node scripts/build.mjs --clean && tsc --sourceMap false && node scripts/build-3d.mjs && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.preview:pages: node scripts/build.mjs --clean --base=/jemawe && tsc --sourceMap false && node scripts/build-3d.mjs && node scripts/check-dist.mjs --base=/jemawe && node scripts/serve.mjs --base=/jemawe
